candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503 and order /v1/orders to fail with ReadTimeout, propagating 502s at gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics/logs admitted; root cause of the Redis timeouts (saturation, network, config) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out with DependencyUnavailable across multiple correlation IDs, inventory returning 503, order failing with ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout returning 502 with p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. This bounds the fault to Redis dependency timeouts; the underlying Redis cause remains unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side metrics and logs to confirm the timeout origin
